cards.title: Service & Parts Have No AI-Indexable Entity
cards.body: No Service GBP profile and no Parts GBP profile exist — confirmed in the audit. GBP profiles are the primary structured entity that AI engines index for local businesses. Without them, those departments have no indexable presence for AI to reference. Note: whether a query like “Mitsubishi service Greece NY” on ChatGPT or Perplexity currently returns James Mitsubishi was not directly tested — but there is no GBP entity for AI to draw from.

cards.title: Nearly 7 Months of Content Silence
cards.body: Last GBP post confirmed as March 17, 2026 — 7 months with zero published content. AI engines that favor fresh, locally optimized content when selecting sources for generated answers have had nothing from this dealership to reference since then. Competitors publishing weekly are producing the content AI engines actively prioritize.
cards.pill: CLIKsearch — Weekly SEO/AEO/GEO Content Posts

cards.title: Directory Sync Not Deployed
cards.body: The audit confirmed that 60+ directory syndication has not been deployed — it is listed as an open opportunity. AI engines including ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Bing Copilot are known to draw from third-party directory data for business information. The actual extent of NAP inconsistency across those directories was not directly audited — a dedicated NAP audit across Yelp, CarGurus, DealerRater, and Cars.com would be needed to quantify this gap.

cards.title: AEO/FAQ Content Strategy Absent
cards.body: No AEO content strategy is evident from the posting record since March 17, 2026. FAQ schema and structured Q&A content were not specifically audited — this gap is inferred from the overall content dormancy and schema incompleteness confirmed in the GBP audit. A dedicated schema audit would be needed to confirm or rule out the presence of FAQ/HowTo structured data on the website.

cards.title: Active Knowledge Panel — Verified AI Foundation
cards.body: A verified, active Google Business Profile with a prominent Knowledge Panel is the primary prerequisite for AI search visibility — confirmed in the audit. This is the exact foundation CLIKsearch builds on: corrected schema, active 3-Pack profiles, and weekly content create a compounding AI visibility advantage from this strong starting point.

cards.title: #1 Organic Ranking — Strong Entity Signal
cards.body: Confirmed ranking #1 organically for brand terms in Greece, NY. AI engines weight top-ranking pages as authoritative sources when composing answers. This existing authority — paired with corrected schema, active GBP profiles, and AEO content — creates a strong compounding advantage for AI search visibility. CLIKsearch’s omni-social distribution across 6 platforms creates continuous cross-platform entity citations that multiply this authority signal for AI engine indexing.

cards.title: No Service GBP Profile
cards.body: No Service Google Business Profile listing was found in the audit. The website schema already describes a Service department, but no separate Service listing appears in Google. No “Departments:” line was seen on the Sales listing. Both views: the website’s schema already describes a Service department (audited October 19, 2026) — what is missing is the Google Business Profile listing for it.

cards.title: No Parts GBP Profile
cards.body: No Parts Google Business Profile listing was found in the audit; the website schema already describes a Parts department. Both views: the website’s schema already describes a Parts department (audited October 19, 2026) — what is missing is the Google Business Profile listing for it.

cards.body: No owner posts were visible at audit. The last Google Business Profile post was March 17, 2026 — about 7 months before October 19, 2026. No owner posts were visible on the profile.

cards.title: Yelp and Apple Maps Listings Are Unclaimed

cards.title: Mitsubishi Dealer Locator Phone Mismatch
cards.body: The Mitsubishi dealer locator shows 866-906-1515 instead of the dealership’s (585) 563-2029.

cards.title: Website Schema Hours Differ from Google
cards.body: Google lists opening at 8:30 AM, while the website schema lists 9:00 AM for the same days — a 30-minute difference. Closing times match by day.

cards.title: Google Reviews Aren’t Shown on the Website
cards.body: The rendered dealership website did not show reviews; the audit found 1,599 Google reviews at 4.5 stars. Reviews can be displayed visibly to visitors — for example a Google reviews widget or testimonials — without any review markup in the structured data.

cards.title: No areaServed in Site Schema; sameAs Links Only to Facebook
cards.body: Homepage sameAs lists Facebook only; no areaServed was found on the five key pages checked (home, About, Service, Parts, Directions). The homepage has no hasMap property; a Google Maps link (map) appears on the Sales department entity only. The three department entities share the homepage URL and phone. Add hasMap and sameAs pointing to the Google Business Profile URL, and define areaServed. (Effect on entity recognition and local rankings is inferred, not tested.)

cards.title: Strong Google Review Profile
cards.body: Google shows 4.5 stars from 1,599 reviews. The 10 newest reviews were all 5 stars; the newest was 2 days old, and the owner replied to 8 of 10. Facebook shows 72% recommend across 73 reviews; it does not display a star rating.

cards.title: Sales Listing Is Claimed; No Duplicate Found
cards.body: The Sales Google Business Profile is claimed and verified. No duplicate or unclaimed Google listing was found in the audit searches.

alert.impact_para2: With two revenue departments missing from Google, about seven months of content silence, and no Google Business Profile link in the website’s sameAs schema
locked: Entity Authority: sameAs Links to Facebook Only — Knowledge Graph Signals Are Critically Thin

sameAs is how a site’s structured data points to a business’s other official profiles. This dealership’s lists Facebook only — the Google Business Profile isn’t among the linked profiles — so the site’s entity data is thinner than a fully built profile set.
Market Reach Undefined: No areaServed in Site Schema — Surrounding Markets Not Stated

The site’s structured data defines no areaServed property, so it never states which cities this dealership serves. Greece, NY sits within a large metro market — every city left unstated is a missed chance to say where the dealership competes.
GBP Category Configuration Not Fully Optimized — High-Value Queries Being Missed

Category selection directly determines which searches trigger a GBP listing. Outdated or incomplete configurations suppress visibility for the highest-value transactional queries — financing, service, parts, and new vehicle searches.
